# Offline Pixel Task List

A self-contained, offline pixel-style task list app built with only HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript. No frameworks, no network requests, no external assets.

## Features

- Add tasks via text input and button (or Enter key)
- Blank input is ignored; text is trimmed
- Live total task count and incomplete task count
- Toggle checkbox to mark tasks complete (updates remaining count)
- Delete tasks (updates both counts)
- Tasks get increasing numeric IDs (`todo-text-1`, `todo-check-1`, `todo-delete-1`, etc.)
- All state kept in memory — nothing persisted
- Keyboard-accessible, labeled controls
- Responsive layout down to 360px
- Pixel-style visual design with hover, focus, and pressed states

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Type a task and click **Add** or press **Enter**. Check the box to mark a task done. Click **Delete** to remove it.

## File Structure

- `index.html` — markup
- `styles.css` — pixel-style theme
- `script.js` — task logic
- `README.md` — this file

## Notes

No storage is used; refreshing the page resets the list. The app uses the `hidden` attribute with a CSS rule to ensure it always hides elements when set.
